gaps.explanation: detail[] had no business-type lines. Added one line per printed non-zero row per enterprise fund column: major funds from trimmed p11 (Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position, printed p31: Lincoln Wastewater System, Lincoln Water System, Lincoln Electric System), individual nonmajor funds from trimmed p37 (Combining Statement - Nonmajor Enterprise Funds, printed p147: Golf, Parking System, Pinnacle Bank Arena, Solid Waste Management, Emergency Medical Services, Broadband Enterprise). The p11 'Other Enterprise Funds' column, the Total columns and the Internal Service Funds column are not added. Self-check: every p37 column re-adds to its printed totals, and every p37 Total-column row equals the p11 Other Enterprise Funds cell (Charges 11,382,209; Fees 15,698,776; Parking 9,841,784; Performance 14,838,804; Other operating 2,318,739; Total operating revenues 54,080,312; Investment (90,090); Lease income 1,154,731; Lease interest 356,879; Grant 295,442; Gain 44,725; Occupation tax 5,336,074). p11 rows re-add to the Total column (e.g. Charges 38,812,883 + 49,975,040 + 348,151,000 + 11,382,209 = 448,321,132). Revenue lines added: operating revenues 511,766,235 + nonoperating revenue rows (investment (563,556) + lease income 1,154,731 + lease interest 356,879 + grant 295,442 + gain 44,725 + insurance recoveries 2,914,808 + occupation tax 5,336,074 = 9,539,103) = 521,305,338 = JSON business-type receipts and reported_totals. Investment losses are kept as printed (negative) in revenue, as the statement line is. Schedule 0 + 521,305,338 = 521,305,338: tie ok.
